subject: Post-call: ShopCentric trial alignment — success metrics & model recommendation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@shopcentric.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: ShopCentric trial alignment — success metrics & model recommendation

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier — appreciate the clarity on the search and recommendations use case. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of needs
- Primary: product search ranking + short answer suggestions for product pages (EN/ES/PT).
- Volume profile: ~120 reqs/sec peak, mostly short contexts (<=128 tokens).
- Quality bar: intent accuracy high (customer-facing suggestions), low hallucination on product facts.

Proposed POC charter (2 weeks)
1) Integration (Days 1–3): minimal SDK integration + prefix routing for catalog context.
2) Validation (Days 4–10): run evaluation suite (we'll use your seed queries + shop-centric eval set) and collect metrics.
3) Acceptance (Days 11–14): throughput/latency verification and a joint sign-off demo.

Success criteria (what ShopCentric told us you care about)
- Intent/label accuracy >= 92% on the shared eval set (weighted for intent/slot correctness).
- Hallucination rate <= 2% (measured by random sample checks).
- P50 latency < 350ms with target batching for peak load; p95 < 750ms.
- Cost target: average inference cost <= $0.35 per 1k requests (pilot target to validate).

Model recommendations (initial shortlist)
- Primary (open): Llama 2 13B — quantized to int8-quant profile for perf/cost; good instruction-following baseline.
- Fallback (latency/cost): Mistral 7B (instruct-tuned variant) — smaller footprint, fast response for short prompts.
- Safety/guardrail: we’ll run a lightweight reranker (ensemble) on critical product outputs to reduce hallucinations.

Multilingual plan
- We’ll fine-tune the prompt and caching rules to bias for EN/ES/pt_BR. If we see consistent regression in Portuguese, fallback routing to Mistral 7B will be tested for that locale.

Ownership & asks
- Monica (me): POC lead / commercial.
- Rishi: runtime + perf owner (config, perf testing).
- Aditya: prompt/eval owner (build eval harness, label checks).
- Priyom: CS lead for acceptance criteria and internal coordination.

Please review the attached POc charter and the eval CSV I pulled together with your sample queries. If this looks good we’ll: 1) confirm start date (we proposed Mon Jul 24) and 2) provision a dedicated trial route and sample tokens for your integration.

Next steps
- Elena: confirm SOC2/PII constraints and whether we need to sign any additional DPA before integration.
- Everyone here: confirm the timeline and acceptance criteria; we’ll send a calendar invite for kickoff.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Post-call: ShopCentric trial alignment — success metrics & model recommendation

Thanks Monica — this is exactly what I needed. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) Timeline — Jul 24 start is fine for us if we can have a 1-hour kickoff on Monday morning (9am PT).
2) Security/DPA — we are SOC2 Type II and will need to see the SOC2 report or equivalent evidence for the trial; we also have a short DPA addendum for data retention (30 days for trial logs).
3) Eval set — I attached a short internal doc with our customer-sentiment scoring and a CSV of ~400 seed queries (we’ll upload the larger corpus after kickoff).

Can your team confirm whether the proposed model pair (Llama 2 13B primary / Mistral 7B fallback) supports our requirement to keep PII out of logs by default? If not, we’ll need to sign off on config options before ingestion.

Best,
Elena
VP Product | ShopCentric
elena@shopcentric.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: ShopCentric trial alignment — success metrics & model recommendation

Hi all — quick tech notes from the runtime side (copied from call notes).

- SOC2/logging: We can disable request/response retention for the trial; we also support token-level redaction and customer-managed KMS for any encrypted artifacts. For the POC we suggest request-only minimal audit logs (no payload retention) to satisfy your 30-day policy.
- Model variants: Recommend using Llama 2 13B -> q8_0 quant profile for the primary route to hit the p50 target cost/latency. For fallback, Mistral 7B (instruct) quantized to q4_0 is a good low-latency option.
- HW: For the integration window use one g5.12xlarge-like instance (or equivalent A100 cluster) for validation; scale later to a 2x GPU pool for throughput testing.
- Caching: enable prefix caching for catalog lookups (we’ll share the suggested TTLs in the appendix).

Attachments: runtime-recommendation-appendix.pdf

I’ll prepare a short perf test plan (p50/p95 runs + synthetic peak) that Aditya and I can run once you hand over an API key.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
